notes.title: Gamescom 2025 Recap: Serial World’s first time overseas!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hi, everyone! 👋[/b][/h1][p]After all of the excitement at Gamescom, we needed some time to hibernate and rest, but now we’re back and more ready than ever to jump into Serial World’s development again![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thank you to everyone who played Serial World at Gamescom![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021996/bb2fa5970af37b50c0dae86897db61c6f6e76517.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]It was so much fun seeing players experience our game in real life, and this was [b]our very first time traveling overseas! [/b]You made our first event so memorable, and gave us so much encouragement, feedback, and support. We can’t thank you enough!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021996/a5786d69ea399623aa3e7a737924cd7363ff43cc.jpg"][/img][i]Rocking matching Serial World shirts with some of our friends from our publisher, Kakehashi Games! (Takashi is second from left, and Sho is far right.)[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]It was hard to narrow down what our favorite memories from Gamescom were, but here’s a little story from each of us on what stuck with us most:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]"A particular memory that stands out for me is a child who played our game [i][b]four times![/b][/i][b] [/b]He kept challenging the game, with his mother watching over him kindly from behind. This is something we often see at events in Japan, and it really made me feel like Serial World has the potential to reach people all over the world, just as it does in Japan. [/p][p]At the end, he told me, "I want to be the first person in the world to play this game when it's released!" I was really moved by that, and it's become a great source of encouragement for our future development. Just you wait, my German friend! (I wish I had asked for his name!)" [b]- Sho (Artist)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]"It was a pleasure to see such a wide range of people, from kids to adults, playing our game throughout Gamescom. I had been worried that the deck-building genre, with its many rules and text, would only appeal to a niche audience of core gamers, but after seeing people actually play the game, I felt reassured that it could be enjoyed by anyone!" [b]- Takashi (Programmer)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Now that we’ve gotten some proper rest and recovered from our flights home (13+ hours!! 😵), [b]we’re ready to take everything we learned at Gamescom and make Serial World even more fun for you all![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]We’ll see you real soon with more updates! Bye for now! 🚪[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021996/e98a51c888aee36fb1b4a1d1f8c1d933187fd32c.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Serial World is exhibiting at BitSummit 2025!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, RPG fans! We are Serial Project, and we have big news…[/h3][h1][b]Serial World is coming to BitSummit![/b][/h1][p]We’re so excited to bring Serial World to Kyoto for the very first time, and we’ve got a [b]brand new demo to share with you![/b] Be sure to stop by and check it out to meet some new characters and explore the dungeons![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021996/a8b5ec268c8c9e51777eac955455349aa63cee68.png"][/img][/p][h3]You may also notice something else…[/h3][h1][b]Serial World has a brand new publisher![/b][/h1][p]Yes, we’re very happy to share that [b]Kakehashi Games [/b]is publishing our game, and will be helping with our overseas marketing and support. We have lots of surprises heading your way, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021996/1a53bd0a52f9dc6b11fdf160729bb4f7cdd97972.png"][/img][/p][p]We hope to see you at BitSummit! In the meantime, don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam… it helps a lot![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2979500/Serial_World/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Exhibiting at Digital Games Expo 2024!

The venue is Akihabara’s UDX, a prime spot with a lot of international visitors expected! Better get our English practice in before the big day.

notes.title: SerialWorld is coming to Tokyo Game Show 2024!

This will be the second time SerialWorld is available for hands-on play, and you’ll get to see the evolved characters in action—better than ever!

Come experience the latest version of SerialWorld, a comical yet serious RPG, live at the show!
